name: Duplicate a folder from a name and an id

parameters.formDescription: Uploads the clip to https://greenkey.mxjprod.work, copies the influencer template, writes the name and the id, and opens the project. Quit After Effects before you run this form. Keep this page open. It shows the folder when the job finishes.

values.formSubmittedText: Greenkey finished. The folder is copied. After Effects is opening the project.

parameters.command:
={{(() => {
  const templateFolder = "/Users/glaucomp/Desktop/PackageMaker/ss-influencer";
  const jobsFolder = "/Users/glaucomp/Desktop/PackageMaker/jobs";
  const projectFileName = "ss-Influencer.aep";
  const scriptPath = "/Users/glaucomp/n8n-sugar-scratch/local/after-effects/duplicate_job.py";
  const q = (value) => "'" + String(value ?? "").replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";
  function incoming() {
    try {
      return $("On form submission").item.json;
    } catch (error) {}
    const hook = $("Influencer webhook").item.json;
    const body = hook.body && typeof hook.body === "object" ? hook.body : hook;
    return body;
  }
  const form = incoming();
  const progressUrl = String(form.progressUrl || "");
  const progressToken = String(form.progressToken || "");
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ name: form.name, id: form.id, clip: form.clip });
return [
    "if command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1; then",
    "bash <<'BASH'",
    "set -euo pipefail",
    "export INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_URL=" + q(progressUrl),
    "export INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_TOKEN=" + q(progressToken),
    "say() {",
    "  printf '%s\\n' \"$1\"",
    "  if [ -n \"${INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_URL:-}\" ]; then",
    "    INFLUENCER_LINE=\"$1\" python3 - <<'PY' || true",
    "import json, os, urllib.request",
    "url = os.environ.get('INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_URL', '').strip()",
    "token = os.environ.get('INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_TOKEN', '').strip()",
    "line = os.environ.get('INFLUENCER_LINE', '')",
    "if url and line:",
    "    data = json.dumps({'line': line}).encode()",
    "    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method='POST', headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Progress-Token': token})",
    "    urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5).read()",
    "PY",
    "  fi",
    "}",
    "say \"n8n: uploading the clip to Greenkey\"",
    "if [ ! -f " + q(scriptPath) + " ]; then",
    "  say \"influencer-n8n-error: script not found\"",
    "  echo \"Script not found: " + scriptPath + "\" >&2",
    "  exit 1",
    "fi",
    "python3 " + q(scriptPath) + " \\",
    "  --template " + q(templateFolder) + " \\",
    "  --jobs " + q(jobsFolder) + " \\",
    "  --name " + q(form.name) + " \\",
    "  --id " + q(form.id) + " \\",
    "  --clip " + q(form.clip) + " \\",
    "  --project " + q(projectFileName),
    "BASH",
    "else",
    "export INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_URL=" + q(progressUrl),
    "export INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_TOKEN=" + q(progressToken),
    "export INFLUENCER_PAYLOAD=" + q(payload),
    "node <<'NODE'",
    "const http = require('http');",
    "const https = require('https');",
    "const {URL} = require('url');",
    "function rewrite(url) {",
    "  return String(url || '').replace(/127\\.0\\.0\\.1/g, 'host.docker.internal').replace(/localhost/g, 'host.docker.internal');",
    "}",
    "function post(urlString, payload, token) {",
    "  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {",
    "    const url = new URL(urlString);",
    "    const body = Buffer.from(typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload));",
    "    const lib = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;",
    "    const req = lib.request({",
    "      hostname: url.hostname,",
    "      port: url.port || (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),",
    "      path: url.pathname + url.search,",
    "      method: 'POST',",
    "      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': body.length, 'X-Progress-Token': token || ''},",
    "    }, (res) => {",
    "      const chunks = [];",
    "      res.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));",
    "      res.on('end', () => resolve({status: res.statusCode, body: Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')}));",
    "    });",
    "    req.setTimeout(7200000, () => req.destroy(new Error('timeout')));",
    "    req.on('error', reject);",
    "    req.write(body);",
    "    req.end();",
    "  });",
    "}",
    "(async () => {",
    "  const token = process.env.INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_TOKEN || '';",
    "  const base = rewrite(process.env.INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_URL || '');",
    "  async function say(line) {",
    "    process.stdout.write(line + '\\n');",
    "    if (!base) return;",
    "    try { await post(base, {line}, token); } catch (error) {}",
    "  }",
    "  await say('n8n: uploading the clip to Greenkey');",
    "  await say('n8n: running the Mac steps from this workflow');",
    "  const runUrl = base ? base.replace(/\\/$/, '') + '/run' : 'http://host.docker.internal:8090/api/internal/influencer-run';",
    "  const result = await post(runUrl, process.env.INFLUENCER_PAYLOAD || '{}', token || 'local-influencer-run');",
    "  process.stdout.write(result.body + '\\n');",
    "  if (result.status !== 200) {",
    "    await say('influencer-n8n-error: ' + String(result.body || '').trim() || ('the Mac step returned ' + result.status));",
    "    process.exit(1);",
    "  }",
    "  try {",
    "    const parsed = JSON.parse(result.body);",
    "    const folder = String(parsed.line || '').replace(/^influencer-n8n-result:\\s*/, '');",
    "    if (folder) process.stdout.write('Folder: ' + folder + '\\n');",
    "  } catch (error) {}",
    "})().catch((error) => {",
    "  process.stderr.write(String(error && error.stack || error) + '\\n');",
    "  process.exit(1);",
    "});",
    "NODE",
    "fi",
  ].join("\n");
})()}}

nodes.name: Copy and edit
nodes.notes: Uploads the clip to Greenkey, copies the template, writes the name and the id, and sends each line to the waiting page.

nodes.name: Start After Effects
nodes.notes: Opens the copy and relinks footage to the edited files.

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ "Greenkey finished. The folder is copied. After Effects is opening the project.\n" + (($("Start After Effects").first().json.stdout.match(/Folder: .*/) || [""])[0]) }}

nodes.name: Show the result
nodes.notes: Shows the finished folder on the form page after Greenkey and After Effects.
